Title: Introduction to Pattern Recognition
Text: Fundamental concepts of statistical and structural pattern recognition, feature vector representations, decision boundaries, Bayes theorem, and nearest neighbor classification.

Title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
Text: Convolutional neural networks, visual feature extraction, image classification, object detection, spatial pooling, and transfer learning architectures.

Title: Linear Algebra and Vector Spaces
Text: Vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, matrix decompositions, orthogonal projections, and principal component analysis.

Title: Probability and Random Processes
Text: Probability distributions, random variables, expectation, variance, Markov chains, stochastic processes, and maximum likelihood estimation.

Title: Classical Mechanics and Kinematics
Text: Newtonian mechanics, Lagrangian formalism, harmonic oscillators, motion in potential fields, rotational dynamics, and conservation laws.

Title: Quantum Mechanics and Wavefunctions
Text: Wave-particle duality, Schrodinger equation, Hilbert space representations, quantum state vectors, operators, and probability densities.

Title: Digital Signal Processing and Wavelets
Text: Sampling theory, discrete Fourier transform, z-transform, digital filters, frequency spectrum analysis, and wavelet decomposition.

Title: Microelectronic Circuits and Semiconductor Devices
Text: Semiconductor physics, MOSFET amplifiers, operational amplifiers, frequency response, feedback circuits, and VLSI design.

Title: Machine Learning and Statistical Inference
Text: Supervised learning, unsupervised clustering, support vector machines, decision trees, bias-variance tradeoff, and cross-validation techniques.

Title: Big Data Analytics and Data Mining
Text: Distributed computing, MapReduce, associative rule mining, anomaly detection, scalable dimensionality reduction, and clustering algorithms.

Title: Natural Language Processing and Text Embeddings
Text: Text tokenization, TF-IDF representations, word embeddings, sequence-to-sequence models, attention mechanisms, and transformer networks.

Title: Reinforcement Learning and Markov Decision Processes
Text: Agent environment interaction, Q-learning, policy gradients, Bellman optimality equations, exploration versus exploitation.

Title: Multivariable Calculus and Optimization
Text: Gradient descent, convex optimization, Lagrange multipliers, Hessian matrices, partial derivatives, and saddle point analysis.

Title: Graph Theory and Network Algorithms
Text: Graph representations, shortest path algorithms, spectral graph theory, adjacency matrices, centrality measures, and network flow.

Title: Electromagnetism and Maxwell Equations
Text: Electric and magnetic fields, Maxwell equations, electromagnetic waves, boundary value problems, and vector calculus in physics.

Title: Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics
Text: Entropy, partition functions, microcanonical ensembles, thermodynamic potentials, phase transitions, and Boltzmann distributions.

Title: Control Systems and Feedback Dynamics
Text: State space representations, transfer functions, root locus, Bode plots, PID controllers, and stability criteria.

Title: Communication Systems and Modulation
Text: Analog and digital modulation, noise in communication channels, Shannon channel capacity, error-correcting codes, and spectrum efficiency.

Title: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
Text: Autoregressive integrated moving average models, seasonal decomposition, stationarity testing, exponential smoothing, and anomaly detection.

Title: Information Retrieval and Vector Search Engines
Text: Cosine similarity retrieval, inverted index, dense vector search, TF-IDF ranking, precision-recall evaluation, and semantic search.

Title: Computer Graphics and Geometric Modeling
Text: 3D transformations, polygon meshes, ray tracing, shading algorithms, rendering pipeline, and spatial acceleration structures.

Title: Compiler Design and Formal Languages
Text: Lexical analysis, syntax trees, context-free grammars, intermediate code generation, optimization passes, and register allocation.

Title: Numerical Methods and Scientific Computing
Text: Numerical linear algebra, root finding algorithms, numerical integration, finite difference methods, and error propagation.

Title: Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems
Text: Ordinary and partial differential equations, phase portraits, stability analysis, bifurcation theory, and Fourier series solutions.

Title: Optics and Laser Physics
Text: Interference, diffraction, geometric optics, laser resonators, optical fibers, photonics, and polarization of light waves.

Title: Solid State Physics and Band Theory
Text: Crystal lattices, Brillouin zones, energy bands, semiconductors, phonons, and electrical conductivity in metals.

Title: Wireless Sensor Networks and IoT Systems
Text: Sensor nodes, wireless protocols, energy harvesting, edge computing, distributed signal processing, and mesh networking.

Title: Power Electronics and Electric Drives
Text: Inverters, rectifiers, DC-DC converters, motor drive control, renewable energy integration, and grid synchronization.

Title: Unsupervised Feature Learning and Clustering
Text: K-means clustering, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, t-SNE projections, autoencoders, and self-organizing maps.

Title: Predictive Modeling and Ensemble Learning
Text: Random forests, gradient boosting machines, XGBoost, stacking classifiers, model interpretability, and SHAP values.
